109class UWorldProxy
110{
111public:
112
113 UWorldProxy() :
114 World(NULL)
115 {}
116
117 inline UWorld* operator->()
118 {
119 // GWorld is changed often on the game thread when in PIE, accessing on any other thread is going to be a race condition
120 // In general, the rendering thread should not dereference UObjects, unless there is a mechanism in place to make it safe
121 checkSlow(IsInGameThread());
122 return World;
123 }
124
125 inline const UWorld* operator->() const
126 {
127 checkSlow(IsInGameThread());
128 return World;
129 }
130
131 inline UWorld& operator*()
132 {
133 checkSlow(IsInGameThread());
134 return *World;
135 }
136
137 inline const UWorld& operator*() const
138 {
139 checkSlow(IsInGameThread());
140 return *World;
141 }
142
143 inline UWorldProxy& operator=(UWorld* InWorld)
144 {
145 World = InWorld;
146 return *this;
147 }
148
149 inline UWorldProxy& operator=(const UWorldProxy& InProxy)
150 {
151 World = InProxy.World;
152 return *this;
153 }
154
155 inline bool operator==(const UWorldProxy& Other) const
156 {
157 return World == Other.World;
158 }
159
160 inline operator UWorld*() const
161 {
162 checkSlow(IsInGameThread());
163 return World;
164 }
165
166 inline UWorld* GetReference()
167 {
168 checkSlow(IsInGameThread());
169 return World;
170 }
171
172private:
173
174 UWorld* World;
175};

178class FAudioDeviceWorldDelegates
179{
180public:
181 // Called whenever a world is registered to an audio device. UWorlds are not guaranteed to be registered to the same
182 // audio device throughout their lifecycle, and there is no guarantee on the lifespan of both the UWorld and the Audio
183 // Device registered in this callback.
184 DECLARE_MULTICAST_DELEGATE_TwoParams(FOnWorldRegisteredToAudioDevice, const UWorld* /*InWorld */, Audio::FDeviceId /* AudioDeviceId*/);
185 static UE_API FOnWorldRegisteredToAudioDevice OnWorldRegisteredToAudioDevice;
186
187 // Called whenever a world is unregistered from an audio device. UWorlds are not guaranteed to be registered to the same
188 // audio device throughout their lifecycle, and there is no guarantee on the lifespan of both the UWorld and the Audio
189 // Device registered in this callback.
190 DECLARE_MULTICAST_DELEGATE_TwoParams(FOnWorldUnregisteredWithAudioDevice, const UWorld* /*InWorld */, Audio::FDeviceId /* AudioDeviceId*/);
191 static UE_API FOnWorldUnregisteredWithAudioDevice OnWorldUnregisteredWithAudioDevice;
192};

294struct FLevelViewportInfo

296 GENERATED_BODY()
297
298
299 UPROPERTY()
300 FVector CamPosition;
301
303 UPROPERTY()
304 FRotator CamRotation;
305
307 UPROPERTY()
308 float CamOrthoZoom;
309
311 UPROPERTY()
312 bool CamUpdated;
313
314 FLevelViewportInfo()
315 : CamPosition(FVector::ZeroVector)
316 , CamRotation(FRotator::ZeroRotator)
317 , CamOrthoZoom(DEFAULT_ORTHOZOOM)
318 , CamUpdated(false)
319 {
320 }
321
322 FLevelViewportInfo(const FVector& InCamPosition, const FRotator& InCamRotation, float InCamOrthoZoom)
323 : CamPosition(InCamPosition)
324 , CamRotation(InCamRotation)
325 , CamOrthoZoom(InCamOrthoZoom)
326 , CamUpdated(false)
327 {
328 }
329
330 // Needed for backwards compatibility for VER_UE4_ADD_EDITOR_VIEWS, can be removed along with it
331 friend FArchive& operator<<( FArchive& Ar, FLevelViewportInfo& I )
332 {
333 Ar << I.CamPosition;
334 Ar << I.CamRotation;
335 Ar << I.CamOrthoZoom;
336
337 if ( Ar.IsLoading() )
338 {
339 I.CamUpdated = true;
340
341 if ( I.CamOrthoZoom < MIN_ORTHOZOOM || I.CamOrthoZoom > MAX_ORTHOZOOM )
342 {
343 I.CamOrthoZoom = DEFAULT_ORTHOZOOM;
344 }
345 }
346
347 return Ar;
348 }
349};

419/* Struct of optional parameters passed to SpawnActor function(s). */
420struct FActorSpawnParameters
421{
422 UE_API FActorSpawnParameters();
423
424 /* A name to assign as the Name of the Actor being spawned. If no value is specified, the name of the spawned Actor will be automatically generated using the form [Class]_[Number]. */
425 FName Name;
426
427 /* An Actor to use as a template when spawning the new Actor. The spawned Actor will be initialized using the property values of the template Actor. If left NULL the class default object (CDO) will be used to initialize the spawned Actor. */
428 AActor* Template;
429
430 /* The Actor that spawned this Actor. (Can be left as NULL). */
431 AActor* Owner;
432
433 /* The APawn that is responsible for damage done by the spawned Actor. (Can be left as NULL). */
434 APawn* Instigator;
435
436 /* The ULevel to spawn the Actor in, i.e. the Outer of the Actor. If left as NULL the Outer of the Owner is used. If the Owner is NULL the persistent level is used. */
437 class ULevel* OverrideLevel;
438
439#if WITH_EDITOR
440 /* The UPackage to set the Actor in. If left as NULL the Package will not be set and the actor will be saved in the same package as the persistent level. */
441 class UPackage* OverridePackage;
442
444 FStringView InitialActorLabel;
445
447 FGuid OverrideActorGuid;
448#endif
449
450 /* The parent component to set the Actor in. */
451 class UChildActorComponent* OverrideParentComponent;
452
454 ESpawnActorCollisionHandlingMethod SpawnCollisionHandlingOverride;
455
457 ESpawnActorScaleMethod TransformScaleMethod = ESpawnActorScaleMethod::MultiplyWithRoot;
458
459private:
460
461 friend class UPackageMapClient;
462
463 friend class UNetActorFactory;
464
465 /* Is the actor remotely owned. This should only be set true by the package map when it is creating an actor on a client that was replicated from the server. */
466 uint8 bRemoteOwned:1;
467
468public:
469
470 bool IsRemoteOwned() const { return bRemoteOwned; }
471
472 /* Determines whether spawning will not fail if certain conditions are not met. If true, spawning will not fail because the class being spawned is `bStatic=true` or because the class of the template Actor is not the same as the class of the Actor being spawned. */
473 uint8 bNoFail:1;
474
475 /* Determines whether the construction script will be run. If true, the construction script will not be run on the spawned Actor. Only applicable if the Actor is being spawned from a Blueprint. */
476 uint8 bDeferConstruction:1;
477
478 /* Determines whether or not the actor may be spawned when running a construction script. If true spawning will fail if a construction script is being run. */
479 uint8 bAllowDuringConstructionScript:1;
480
481#if !WITH_EDITOR
482 /* Force the spawned actor to use a globally unique name (provided name should be none). */
483 uint8 bForceGloballyUniqueName:1;
484#else
485 /* Determines whether the begin play cycle will run on the spawned actor when in the editor. */
486 uint8 bTemporaryEditorActor:1;
487
488 /* Determines whether or not the actor should be hidden from the Scene Outliner */
489 uint8 bHideFromSceneOutliner:1;
490
492 uint16 bCreateActorPackage:1;
493#endif
494
495 /* Modes that SpawnActor can use the supplied name when it is not None. */
496 enum class ESpawnActorNameMode : uint8
497 {
498 /* Fatal if unavailable, application will assert */
499 Required_Fatal,
500
501 /* Report an error return null if unavailable */
502 Required_ErrorAndReturnNull,
503
504 /* Return null if unavailable */
505 Required_ReturnNull,
506
507 /* If the supplied Name is already in use the generate an unused one using the supplied version as a base */
508 Requested
509 };
510
511 /* In which way should SpawnActor should treat the supplied Name if not none. */
512 ESpawnActorNameMode NameMode;
513
514 /* Flags used to describe the spawned actor/object instance. */
515 EObjectFlags ObjectFlags;
516
517 /* Custom function allowing the caller to specific a function to execute post actor construction but before other systems see this actor spawn. */
518 TFunction<void(AActor*)> CustomPreSpawnInitialization;
519};

1915
1916 // Storing PPVs safely is somewhat awkward due to historical API decisions.
1917 // We want to store IInterface_PostProcessVolume*, but callers do not always properly call the Remove function,
1918 // which leads to dangling pointers.
1919 // Most PPVs are UObject-based, and so can use TWeakInterfacePtr to detect object expiration.
1920 // The API signature historically allows for passing a raw pointer though, so we also support those cases for now.
1921 // TLDR: Variant type for PPV storage: UObject-based PPVs use TWeakInterfacePtr (detects stale entries),
1922 // non-UObject raw pointer PPVs are assumed always valid.
1923 using FPostProcessVolumeEntry = TVariant<
1924 TWeakInterfacePtr<IInterface_PostProcessVolume>,
1925 IInterface_PostProcessVolume*>;
1926
1928 struct FPostProcessVolumeIterator
1929 {
1930 struct FSentinel {};
1931
1932 struct FIterator
1933 {
1934 FIterator(const TConstArrayView<FPostProcessVolumeEntry> InEntries, int32 InIndex)
1935 : Entries(InEntries), Index(InIndex)
1936 {
1937 AdvanceToValid();
1938 }
1939
1940 IInterface_PostProcessVolume& operator*() const { return *Current; }
1941
1942 FIterator& operator++()
1943 {
1944 ++Index;
1945 AdvanceToValid();
1946 return *this;
1947 }
1948
1949 bool operator!=(FSentinel) const { return Current != nullptr; }
1950
1951 private:
1952 UE_API void AdvanceToValid();
1953
1954 const TConstArrayView<FPostProcessVolumeEntry> Entries;
1955 int32 Index;
1956 IInterface_PostProcessVolume* Current = nullptr;
1957 };

1961 {}
1962
1963 FIterator begin() const { return FIterator(Entries, 0); }
1964 FSentinel end() const { return {}; }
1965
1966 private:

1968 };

3844
3850 template< class T >
3851 T* SpawnActorDeferred(
3852 UClass* Class,
3853 FTransform const& Transform,
3854 AActor* Owner = nullptr,
3855 APawn* Instigator = nullptr,
3856 ESpawnActorCollisionHandlingMethod CollisionHandlingOverride = ESpawnActorCollisionHandlingMethod::Undefined,
3857 ESpawnActorScaleMethod TransformScaleMethod = ESpawnActorScaleMethod::MultiplyWithRoot
3858 )
3859 {
3860 if( Owner )
3861 {
3862 check(this==Owner->GetWorld());
3863 }
3864 FActorSpawnParameters SpawnInfo;
3865 SpawnInfo.SpawnCollisionHandlingOverride = CollisionHandlingOverride;
3866 SpawnInfo.TransformScaleMethod = TransformScaleMethod;
3867 SpawnInfo.Owner = Owner;
3868 SpawnInfo.Instigator = Instigator;
3869 SpawnInfo.bDeferConstruction = true;
3870 return (Class != nullptr) ? Cast<T>(SpawnActor(Class, &Transform, SpawnInfo)) : nullptr;
3871 }

4765inline bool UWorld::IsNetMode(ENetMode Mode) const
4766{
4767#if UE_EDITOR

4774 return IsRunningDedicatedServer();

4777 {
4778 return !IsRunningDedicatedServer() && (InternalGetNetMode() == Mode);
